findings.evidence: Numeric targets are explicitly labelled as targets and point to future Report 5 evidence.
findings.why_it_matters: Reviewers need to distinguish requirement baselines from achieved measurements.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; Report 5 must preserve the same evidence rule.

findings.evidence: PTE Academic independence, Student self-payment, mobile delivery, advanced anti-cheat, and deferred reports are explicit out-of-scope rows.
findings.why_it_matters: Review scope cannot mistake deferred or excluded items for missing requirements.
findings.required_action: No blocking action; downstream reports must retain these boundaries.
